entry.title: 知识库没命中时去官网补查，每晚十点汇总给我看

link.title: 知识库没命中时去官网补查，每晚十点汇总给我看

entry.content:
给马莫百科机器人加上只许大模型摘原句的 RAG 后，答不上的问题少了不少，但用下来还是老有两类消息转到我微信里。

有时候是同学问得太口语，比如“下学期不想读了先停半年怎么弄”，知识库里明明有 intermission 的说明，但字面上几乎不重合，本地检索根本捞不到。还有时候是我每周定时爬一次官网，总有漏爬的页面，或者官网刚改完还没赶上下一次同步。另外夹着一堆跟学校政策无关的日常问题，像马来西亚用什么转换插头、吉隆坡下雨带什么衣服，其实用不着真人回。

这周在 wxbot/websearch.py 里把本地未命中之后的流程补齐了。原有的顺序一点没动：已教问答、Monash Hub 接口、马莫百科文章、本地 RAG 永远排在最前面，本地能答上就直接回，不走外网搜索，也不会往库里多塞重复条目。

政策题改写再去官网搜，生活题直接让 AI 兜底

之前试过让免费模型直接写政策回答，结果它自己编了宽限期和申请步骤，所以这次没有一刀切全交给 AI。

本地没命中后，先过一遍 is_high_risk()。涉及签证、学费、选课、考试、成绩、毕业、休学、特殊考虑、课程代码和学校政策的，算高风险。天气、转换插头、手机卡、Grab、附近吃饭这些，算低风险。

高风险问题先让模型把口语翻成两三个中英文检索词，比如把“先停半年”改写成 Monash Malaysia intermission 和 休学 申请，然后拿着新词先重查一遍本地 RAG。很多时候东西本来就在本地库里，换个词就捞出来了。

本地重查还是没有，就调 Tavily 搜 monash.edu.my 和 monash.edu，结果里 monash.edu.my 排在前面。拿回来的正文不让模型自由发挥，照样送进 rag.py 逐字核对原文，澳洲页面照样挂“澳洲校区，马来西亚校区不一定一样”的标头。核对不通过，或者什么都没搜到，就老老实实转给我。

写完跑测试时顺手抓出一个挺隐蔽的坑：本地 RAG 在一片片段都没搜到时会返回 Result(None, "no chunks")，此时 unsure 是 False，原来 Brain.answer() 里走了 else 分支直接提前返回 miss，根本没走到后面的改写和 Tavily 逻辑。改完只在本地确实有回答（reply is not None）时提前返回，才真正接上。

低风险的生活问题走到这里，会由 life_fallback() 直接生成一段简短回复，末尾固定带一句“以上由 AI 整理，非学校官方信息，仅供参考”，默认不再转给我。同学觉得没解决，回一句「人工」照样能转过来。

自动补进知识库，已有问答只提建议不乱改

通过核对的新回答会自动存进 qa 表，同时调用 chunks.sync_qa_row() 增量更新 RAG 片段索引，下次再有人问同样的问题，直接毫秒级命中，不再花搜索和模型额度。

qa 表加了一列 source 区分来源：owner 是我自己教的，auto_web 是官网摘录自动补的，auto_ai 是低风险 AI 回答。auto_ai 存进去时把免责声明一起存了，后面复用不会冒充成我亲手写的答案。

只要碰到库里已经有的问答，代码绝不私自覆盖，而是记一条建议到 kb_proposal 表里等我拍板。比如改写检索词之后命中的是我以前教过的某条问答，就提一条 add_phrase，问我要不要把同学这句口语加进去当同义问法。再比如以前针对单个小问题写过一条很短的“宿舍能带电饭煲吗”，后来又补了一条很全的“宿舍电器和做饭规定”，新答案明显更长、主题又重合，代码会提一条 merge_qa，问我要不要把旧问答的问法并到新条目里并删掉旧的。

每晚十点汇总，看到不对直接说话改

wxbot/bot.py 里挂了个每天一次的汇总任务，到晚上十点把当天自动补充的新条目和还没处理的优化建议合成一条发给我，当天什么都没有就不发。

部署前才想到一个时区细节：程序里用的是服务器本地时间，如果 VPS 是 UTC，默认 WXBOT_AUTO_DIGEST_HOUR=22 会在马来西亚早上六点把我吵醒，设成 14 才对应大马时间晚上十点。

收到汇总后，优化建议回 采纳 P1、采纳 全部 或者 驳回 P1 就行，采纳错了回「撤销」能恢复。如果自动补进来的某条问答看着别扭，我懒得背 改 编号 新答案 这种格式，顺手也在 is_admin 分支里加了 wxbot/admin_nlp.py（普通用户完全进不去）：忘了命令可以直接问“有哪些指令”“怎么拉黑一个人”，想改哪条也可以直接说“把 #128 删掉”或者“把 #128 里的 RM50 改成 RM80，去掉旧网址”。所有口语触发的修改都不会直接落库，先发改前改后对比，我回个 1 才生效，改完照样能「撤销」。

还要观察的地方

公众号有 5 秒回复限制，加上改写检索词和 Tavily 搜索，大概率会走延迟投递，同学得过几秒再发一条消息才能看到结果，个人号和群里倒是没这个限制。Tavily 免费额度每个月 1,000 次，虽然本地优先挡掉了大部分流量，但上线后还是得看一阵子消耗。高风险和低风险目前靠关键词列表切分，肯定有漏网或者误判的词，得盯着每晚十点的汇总慢慢补。
entry.summary: 本地知识库和 RAG 没答上时，学校政策先改写检索词去官网补查并核对原文，日常问题让 AI 兜底并标明非官方，自动补充的条目和合并建议每晚十点汇总发给我

entry.title: Searching Monash websites when the KB misses, with a 10 pm review

link.title: Searching Monash websites when the KB misses, with a 10 pm review

entry.content:
Quote-only RAG cut down how often the bot missed reworded questions, but two kinds of messages still kept ending up in my chat.

Sometimes a student writes very colloquially, like “下学期不想读了先停半年怎么弄” (stop studying for half a year next semester). The KB already covers intermission, but the words barely overlap so local retrieval never pulls it up. Other times a page on monash.edu.my or monash.edu was missed by my weekly crawl or updated between runs. Mixed in with those were everyday questions like plug adapters or rain gear in Kuala Lumpur that do not need a human answer.

I added wxbot/websearch.py to handle what happens after a local miss. Nothing ahead of it changed: taught Q&As, the Monash Hub API, 马莫百科 articles and the local RAG index always run first. If local lookup answers the question, it returns right away without touching Tavily or writing anything to the KB.

Official search for policy questions, labelled AI for everyday ones

Letting a free model improvise policy answers already burned me once, so misses are split in is_high_risk() instead of handing everything to AI. Visas, fees, enrolment, exams, grades, graduation, intermission, special consideration, unit codes and university policies count as high risk. Weather, plug adapters, SIM cards, Grab and nearby food count as low risk.

For a high-risk miss, the model rewrites the colloquial Chinese into two or three short bilingual queries, such as Monash Malaysia intermission and 休学 申请. The bot searches the local RAG index again with those first. Half the time the page was already crawled under formal wording.

If local search still comes up empty, Tavily searches monash.edu.my and monash.edu, sorting monash.edu.my ahead of monash.edu. The returned text never goes to free-form summarisation. It runs through the same verbatim quote check in rag.py, keeping the Australia campus warning headers intact. If no verified quote survives, the question still forwards to me.

Writing the tests caught an annoying bug in Brain.answer(): when local RAG found zero chunks it returned Result(None, "no chunks") with unsure=False, which hit an else branch and returned miss early before ever reaching query rewriting or Tavily. Changing that branch to return early only when reply is not None fixed it.

Low-risk life questions that miss the local layers go to life_fallback(). The reply always ends with a note saying it was written by AI and is not official policy, and it does not auto-forward to me unless the student replies 人工.

Auto-adding new answers, proposing changes to old ones

Verified new answers from Layer 2 and Layer 3 are saved into qa and synced into the RAG chunk table immediately via chunks.sync_qa_row(), so the next student asking the same thing hits the KB directly without another search or model call.

A source column tracks where each row came from: owner, auto_web or auto_ai. An auto_ai row stores the disclaimer as part of the answer text so later hits never look like something I wrote by hand.

Existing Q&As are never overwritten silently. Anything touching them goes into kb_proposal for my review. If query rewriting ends up matching an older Q&A, it queues an add_phrase suggestion for the student’s wording. If a new, broader Q&A is added on the same topic as a short older one (for example, a full hostel appliance answer covering an older rice-cooker Q&A), it queues a merge_qa suggestion to fold the old phrasings into the fuller entry and drop the duplicate.

A 10 pm summary and plain-Chinese edits

A background loop in wxbot/bot.py sends one summary at 10 pm listing Q&As auto-added that day and any open proposals. Quiet days send nothing. One small deployment trap: the loop checks server local time, so on a UTC VPS WXBOT_AUTO_DIGEST_HOUR has to be 14 to land at 10 pm in Malaysia instead of 6 am.

Proposals take 采纳 P1, 采纳 全部 or 驳回 P1, and an approved change can still be rolled back with 撤销. If an auto-added answer in the 10 pm summary looks slightly off, I also added an admin-only parser (wxbot/admin_nlp.py, strictly inside is_admin so normal users can never reach it). I can ask “有哪些指令” when I forget a command, or write “把 #128 删掉” or “把 #128 里的 RM50 改成 RM80，去掉旧网址”. Every write previews the before and after and waits for 1 before touching SQLite, with 撤销 afterwards.

Things to watch

Official account replies still have a 5-second timeout, so adding query rewriting and Tavily makes it more likely to fall into late delivery where the student has to send another message to read the reply; private chats and groups do not have that limit. Tavily’s free plan gives 1,000 searches a month, which should last with local lookup running first, though I will still need to watch usage. The high-risk versus low-risk split is just a keyword regex for now, so edge cases will need adjusting as I read the nightly summaries.
entry.summary: When local rules and RAG miss, policy questions rewrite queries and search Monash websites with verbatim checks, everyday questions get a labelled AI answer, and a 10 pm digest lists auto-additions and merge suggestions.

entry.title: 对单个用户停止转人工，或者不再回复

link.title: 对单个用户停止转人工，或者不再回复

entry.content:
上次给机器人加了消息分流和每人每天 5 条上限，挡掉了大部分闲聊和乱码

用了一段时间发现，只按单条消息判断还是不够

机器人主路径没有大模型，也不会做语气或情感分析，只要句子里带了课程、签证或者问号，答不上来就照样会转给我

如果某个人回答过几次还反复追问，或者说话很不客气，每天 5 条的上限还是会把这些消息送进我的聊天框

我维护这个号不是客服义务，不想因为个别对话坏了心情，所以加了按用户设置的两个档位，普通用户的流程一点没变

分成两档：不转人工和彻底拉黑

收到一条待答通知时，上面已经带着短编号（比如 #42），现在可以直接用这个编号对提问人设限制：

  • 不转 42：机器人能答的问题照常答，但答不上来、对方发「人工」或者私聊要进群，都不再转给我，群里也不再 @ 我
  • 拉黑 42：机器人直接忽略这个人发的所有消息，不回复也不转发
  • 黑名单 和 解除 序号：查看名单，或者手滑之后恢复正常

「不转人工」容易漏掉的是文案

如果后台不转了，前台还回一句“已经转给 Waldo，他看到后会回复你”，或者在文章下面继续附“回复「人工」转给 Waldo”，对方只会接着发

所以在 no_forward 状态下，答不上来和发「人工」只给 Monash Hub 和马莫百科往期文章的链接，部分回答末尾的 ask_owner_tail() 会裁掉，自我介绍和 triage.py 的提示语里提到我的句子也会去掉

同时会把这个人当前还没处理的 open 待答全部标成 ignored，不然隔天超时提醒还是会把旧消息顶上来

不只是改 brain.py

一开始以为在 Brain.handle 开头加两行判断就够了，真看一遍三个通道的入口，漏掉的地方不少

公众号要挡在最前面。wxbot/mp.py 里，打招呼（“你好”）、语音图片提示、首次关注语，以及待发队列 outbox 都在进入 Brain.handle 之前或之外处理。彻底拉黑必须在 MPServer.handle 一进来就返回空字符串，让服务器回微信要求的 success，这样用户端既看不到回复也不会报错

个人号按 wxid 跨私聊和群聊联动。在 wxbot/pcwx.py 里，同一个人私聊的 id 是 pc:<wxid>，在群里 @ 机器人时是 pc:<群id>|<wxid>。现在统一折成 person_key（pc:<wxid>）存表，不管是在私聊还是某个群里设了限制，他换个群 @ 机器人一样生效。另外，被拉黑的人会在群频控（_room_busy）之前被丢掉，避免一个人把整个群每分钟的回复额度刷光

关闭旧待答时的 LIKE 下划线问题。按 pc:<wxid> 批量关掉一个人在各个群里未处理的待答时，SQL 用了 user_id LIKE 'pc:%|' + wxid。微信的 wxid_ 里天生带下划线，在 SQLite 里 _ 是匹配任意单个字符的通配符，所以查出来之后还在 Python 里用 person_key() 再核对了一次，防止误关别人

不能挂在 contact 表上。机器人支持用户发「删除我的数据」清空自己在 log、outbox、pending、contact 里的全部记录。屏蔽规则放在单独的 user_rule 表里，forget_user() 不碰它，不然对方删一次数据就自己解封了

另外加了一层保护，管理员和 OWNER_WXID 不能被加进名单，防止手滑把自己屏蔽掉

还管不到的地方

微信里公众号的 openid（mp:...）和个人微信号的 wxid（pc:...）是两套完全独立的 id，没法自动对应成同一个人

如果同一个人既在公众号发消息又加了个人号，只能两边各设一次
entry.summary: 消息级过滤挡不住同一个人反复发或者说话不客气。现在可以按用户设「不转人工」或「彻底拉黑」，跨私聊和群聊生效，也不影响其他正常用户

entry.title: Stopping forwards from one user, or staying silent

link.title: Stopping forwards from one user, or staying silent

entry.content:
Filtering individual messages and capping each person at 5 forwards a day cleared out most small talk and noise.

After using it for a while, per-message filtering still missed a different case: one specific person. The bot’s main path has no language model and does no tone check. If someone repeats the same question after being answered, or talks rudely while mentioning a unit or visa, up to five messages a day still land in my chat.

I run the account in my own time, not as a support desk. So I added two per-user rules. Everyone else is untouched and still gets forwarded as before.

Two levels: no-forward and mute

Each forwarded note already has a short pending id (#42), so the commands reuse it:

  • 不转 42: the bot still answers anything it knows, but stops forwarding misses, 人工 and private-chat join requests to me, and stops @-ing me in groups.
  • 拉黑 42: complete silence. Every message from that user is dropped.
  • 黑名单 and 解除 <index>: list active rules or lift one if I change my mind.

The easy part to miss in no_forward is the wording. If the bot stops forwarding a user but still replies “passed on to Waldo” or leaves “reply 「人工」 to ask Waldo” under an article, the user just keeps asking.

So under no_forward, misses and 人工 only link Monash Hub and the 马莫百科 archive. Partial answers strip ask_owner_tail(), and the greeting intro and triage.py replies drop any mention of me. Setting either rule also marks that user’s open pending rows as ignored, so the next day’s reminder does not bring them back.

More than a check in brain.py

A two-line check at the top of Brain.handle was not enough once I traced all three WeChat channels.

Official account (wxbot/mp.py). Greetings (“你好”), non-text fallbacks, the first-message welcome and queued outbox replies all run before or outside Brain.handle. A muted user has to be stopped at the top of MPServer.handle, returning plain success so WeChat stays quiet without showing an error.

Personal account across DMs and groups (wxbot/pcwx.py). The same WeChat account arrives as pc:<wxid> in a private chat and pc:<room>@chatroom|<wxid> in a group. Rules are stored under a normalised person_key (pc:<wxid>) so one command covers private chats and every group. Muted users are also dropped before the per-group rate limit (_room_busy), so one muted account cannot burn the group’s quota for other students.

The SQL LIKE underscore trap. Closing a user’s open pending rows across groups queries user_id LIKE 'pc:%|' + wxid. WeChat wxid_ strings contain underscores, which SQLite LIKE treats as a single-character wildcard. The code verifies person_key(row["user_id"]) == key in Python before updating so it never closes someone else’s row.

Outside contact. Any user can send 删除我的数据 to delete their rows from log, outbox, pending and contact. Keeping moderation rules in a separate user_rule table means deleting their own data does not clear a block.

Admins and OWNER_WXID are also checked before writing a rule so I cannot accidentally lock myself out.

What this does not cover

In WeChat, an official account openid (mp:...) and a personal account wxid (pc:...) are unrelated ids. There is no way to link them automatically, so if the same person writes on both channels, each side has to be set separately.
entry.summary: Per-message filtering doesn't stop one user from repeating the same thing or being rude. The bot now supports per-user no-forward and silent mute rules without changing anything for normal users.

entry.title: 为什么「马来西亚校区怎么打印」匹配到了学生签证

link.title: 为什么「马来西亚校区怎么打印」匹配到了学生签证

entry.content:
机器人接入 Monash Hub 提问面板后，有人在上面问了一句“马来西亚校区怎么打印”

机器人没有回怎么打印，先是匹配到了“马来西亚校区在哪”，接着又落到了学生签证那条问答上

为什么会这样

机器人的问答匹配不用模型，靠 jieba 分词加上中文双字组，再用 IDF 算词元重叠（wxbot/kb.py）

在“马来西亚校区怎么打印”里，“怎么”是停用词，“打印”只剩一个词元

而“马来西亚”一个词，加上双字组“马来”“来西”“西亚”，再加上“校区”，一下子占了五六个词元

结果哪个问答里提到“马来西亚”的次数多，分数就被拉到哪边去，真正问的“打印”反而排不上号

“国际生”“本地生”“新生”，还有句尾带一句“学长”，都会把分数往同一类方向拉

先去掉这些词，再比问题本身

改动分两步

第一步是维护两套索引：原来的完整问法索引留着，再建一套 _qa_bare，建索引前把校区、学生类型、年级和称呼这些词从两边都删掉

问题里出现这类词时，就用删完之后剩下的词去 _qa_bare 里匹配

“马来西亚校区怎么打印”去掉前半截只剩“怎么打印”，就能直接对上打印那条

只有删完之后什么都不剩的句子，比如“马来西亚校区在哪里”，才退回完整索引按原句匹配

去掉之后还要保留区分

直接删光会引入另一个错：问“马来西亚校区学生签证怎么续签”，如果不管校区，可能会和“澳洲校区学生签证怎么续签”打平

所以在打分时还留了两条规则：

  • 问答明确写的是另一个校区或者另一类学生，权重直接清零，不参与竞争
  • 问答里写了问题没提到的校区或学生类型，分数乘以 0.95（比 WXBOT_QA_MARGIN 的 0.03 低），避免“本地学生通识课”和普通的“通识课”打成平手

反过来，如果问题点名了“本地生”或“国际生”，而且候选里正好有针对这类学生的问答，没有点名的通用问答也会乘以 0.95 让路

所以“马来西亚校区本地生 MPU”仍然会命中本地生 MPU，而“我是国际生，选课在哪”还是普通的选课问题

中文里几个容易切错的地方

写完第一版正则，一测就碰到了几个边界情况，都补进了 tests/test_context_words.py：

  • “马来西亚学生”指的是本地生，不是校区，但后面跟着“签证”“卡”“邮箱”“宿舍”时又不一样：“马来西亚学生签证”说的是马来西亚校区的学生签证，学生签证是一个词
  • “马来语”“马来文”“马来人”说的是语言或者人群，不能当校区删掉
  • 句尾的“呀”“啊”“呢”“急”“在线等”要先于 jieba 去掉，不然“怎么交呀”会被切成“交呀”，跟“怎么交”对不上；“嘛”不能去，因为“干嘛”是个词

跑了一遍测试集

把 qa/ 目录下所有已教问法，分别在前后拼上各种校区、身份词和语气词，一共生成了 19,446 个问题

改之前有大约 3,500 个匹配到了别的问答，改完剩下 40 个

这 40 个里，一部分是去掉前缀本来就会撞车的（比如差一个“没有”的反义句，在 brain.py 里本来就只当猜测发），另一部分是自动拼出来的自相矛盾的句子，像“我是国际生本地生 MPU”

还管不到的地方

正则里没列到的校区简称或者称呼，还是会留在原句里参与算分，遇到新的就补进 _CONTEXT 和测试里

另外，如果一句话同时问两个校区之间的区别，按现在的规则两边都算冲突，这个还没专门处理
entry.summary: 「马来西亚校区怎么打印」之前匹配到了学生签证，因为「马来西亚」拆出来的词元比「打印」多得多。现在匹配前先去掉校区和提问人身份词

entry.title: Why ‘how to print at Malaysia campus’ matched the student visa answer

link.title: Why ‘how to print at Malaysia campus’ matched the student visa answer

entry.content:
After connecting the bot to Monash Hub’s Ask panel, someone typed “马来西亚校区怎么打印” (how to print at the Malaysia campus).

Instead of the printing guide, the bot matched “马来西亚校区在哪” (where is the Malaysia campus) and then the Student Pass answer.

Why that happened

The bot’s Q&A matcher does not use a language model. It splits text with jieba plus CJK character bigrams and scores IDF-weighted overlap (wxbot/kb.py).

In “马来西亚校区怎么打印”, “怎么” is a stopword and “打印” (print) is one token. “马来西亚” alone produces five tokens (the word and its bigrams), plus “校区”. Whichever stored Q&A mentioned Malaysia the most pulled the score towards itself, and “打印” lost out.

The same thing happened with “国际生” (international student), “本地生” (local student), “新生” (first-year) and a trailing “学长” (senior).

Strip those words before matching

The index now keeps two copies of the Q&A phrasings: the full text as before, and _qa_bare with campus names, student types, “新生” and “学长” removed.

When a question contains any of those words, matching runs on _qa_bare using whatever is left of the question. “马来西亚校区怎么打印” becomes “怎么打印”, which lands straight on the printing answer.

Only when nothing is left (“马来西亚校区在哪里”) does it fall back to the full index.

Keeping the distinction without letting it take over

Dropping campus and student words completely would break cases where the answer actually differs. “马来西亚校区学生签证怎么续签” must not tie with the Australian visa answer.

Two rules stay during scoring:

  • A Q&A written for a different campus or student type gets weight 0.0 and is skipped.
  • A Q&A that names a campus or student type the question did not gets multiplied by 0.95 (far enough below the 0.03 lead margin) so “本地学生通识课” (local student MPU) does not tie with general “通识课”.

The reverse applies for student type: if the question says “本地生” or “国际生” and a pair for that group is in the hits, general pairs drop by 0.95. So “马来西亚校区本地生 MPU” still gets the local MPU answer, while “我是国际生，选课在哪” stays a regular enrolment question.

Chinese edge cases

Writing the regex turned up a few traps, all now pinned in tests/test_context_words.py:

  • “马来西亚学生” means a local student, not the campus, except before things a student owns: in “马来西亚学生签证” or “马来西亚学生卡”, “马来西亚” is the campus and “学生签证” is the topic.
  • “马来语” (Malay language), “马来文” and “马来人” are not the campus and must stay untouched.
  • Clause-final particles (“呀”, “啊”, “呢”, “急”, “在线等”) are stripped before jieba. Otherwise jieba glues “交呀” into one token that misses “怎么交”. “嘛” is kept because “干嘛” is a word.

Checking against the Q&A set

I took every phrasing in qa/ and added combinations of campus, student-type and particle prefixes and suffixes, producing 19,446 test questions.

Before this change, about 3,500 matched a different pair. After it, 40 did. Most of those 40 either clash without prefixes too (such as a “没有” opposite handled as a guess in brain.py) or are contradictory generated inputs like “我是国际生本地生 MPU”.

What is left

Any new slang for a campus or role that is not in _CONTEXT will still be scored as part of the topic until it is added with a test. Questions that explicitly compare two campuses at once are not handled specially either.
entry.summary: 'How to print at Malaysia campus' matched the student visa answer because 'Malaysia' produced five tokens against one for 'print'. Now campus and asker words are stripped before matching.

entry.title: 重新平衡 Monash Hub 首页布局，以及 Playwright 拦下的两个问题

link.title: 重新平衡 Monash Hub 首页布局，以及 Playwright 拦下的两个问题

entry.content:
验收国内只读版桌面端页面的时候，盯着整页截图看出了好几处以前海外站也一直存在的布局和文案问题。这些问题不影响功能，所以拖了好几周都没动，但截成整图一看就特别扎眼

四个顺手修掉的布局与文案问题

  1. 页脚单列向下凸出：页脚里的 功能导航 8 个链接排成了一竖列，而旁边的官方来源和系统入口三列各自只有 3 到 4 行，导致页脚右边大片留白。把 功能导航 改成两列网格（把 找选修课 和 学费查询 也补进去，排成 2 列 × 5 行），同时去掉首页最后一个区块底部叠加的约 160 px 空白，整个页脚立刻齐平
  2. 首页右下角大片空白：之前重要日期只列 4 条，下面的 常用系统 是一堆小胶囊标签，卡片下半截空了一半。把首页重要日期改成默认展示 6 条，下面的标题改成 常用系统入口，每个入口从胶囊改成 2 列带一行用途说明的小卡片（比如 Moodle · 课件与作业、WES · 选课与成绩、Allocate+ · 排课表选班），把留白换成了对新生真正有用的信息
  3. 顶栏命名与优先级：新生常分不清 课程 和 专业与学位 的区别，给家长看 又是灰色小字夹在搜索框旁边，很容易被忽略。把中文文案统一改成 课程查询、学费查询、家长入口；顶栏把 官方指南 放第一项，高频的 WAM/GPA 和 学费查询 提到一级导航，选课工具 下拉只放选课三件套（选课规划、先修图、找选修课），家长入口 做成浅蓝胶囊放进主导航，一眼就能看到
  4. 长指南吸顶目录和课程页收尾：把 /guides/[slug] 原本占在正文上面的章节大纲移到右侧栏吸顶，长政策翻到底也能跳章节；/units/[code] 底部加了一张简短的继续规划卡片，看完课程可以直接跳先修图、选课规划或年份对比

PR #301 合并前，Playwright 拦下了两件事

本地 vitest 单测和 nuxi typecheck 全过之后我提了 PR #301，结果 GitHub Actions 的 Playwright 浏览器测试挂了 2 条用例（桌面和手机各跑一次，76 个里挂了 4 个）：

  • e2e/tests/pwa.spec.ts:32：断言中文版 /manifest.webmanifest 里的快捷方式包含 课程。因为 PWA manifest 直接读了 nav.units，把文案改成 课程查询 后，manifest 快捷方式也跟着变了——提醒了我改一个 i18n 键会影响到页面可见导航以外的地方
  • e2e/tests/units.spec.ts:57：用 page.getByRole('link', { name: /比较年份|Compare years/ }) 定位链接时没加 .first()。我们在课程页底部加了规划卡片后，页面上出现了第二个 比较年份变化 链接，直接触发了 Playwright strict mode 报错

两处都是改一行的测试更新，CI 提前拦下来也避免了线上回归

上线后一眼看出的 CSS Grid 拉伸坑

PR #301 合并部署到海外站后，一刷新首页就发现一个很丑的问题：左栏 8 张入口卡片被拉成了细长条，底下空出一大截灰色

把左右两栏放一起看，原因一下子就清楚了：

  • .hero 设了 align-items: stretch，.tools 又设了 flex: 1 1 auto; grid-auto-rows: 1fr;
  • 右栏把重要日期加到 6 条、常用系统改成 2 列卡片后，整体增高了大约 220 px
  • 国内版左栏是 3×3 九宫格（3 行），每张卡片分摊下来大约 175 px 高，接近正方形，看着很舒服
  • 海外版左栏还是旧的 4×2（只有 2 行），而且漏了 找选修课（/electives），结果 CSS Grid 把这两行强行撑到了每行约 270 px，再加上 align-content: start 把图标和文字顶在最上面，底下就空出了大片灰色

PR #303 的修法比硬写 max-height 更干净：把海外和国内统一成 3×3 九宫格，给海外补上 找选修课（第 9 格海外留 社区，国内放 马莫百科），卡片内部改成 align-content: center 垂直居中，同时把右栏 .hero-side 设为 grid-template-rows: 1fr auto，不管切到马来西亚还是澳大利亚校区，常用系统卡片都不会被拉变形

顺着同一批截图，我还把公众号模块的标题从读起来有点别扭的 马莫同学写的公众号 改成了 马莫学生运营的公众号——这张卡片同时介绍了文章、后台自动回复机器人和关注二维码，“运营的公众号”比“写的公众号”贴切得多
entry.summary: 修掉单列凸出的页脚、不显眼的家长入口、被拉成细长条的 4×2 首页卡片，以及 Playwright 在合并前拦下的两个回归问题

entry.title: Rebalancing the Monash Hub home page, and what Playwright caught

link.title: Rebalancing the Monash Hub home page, and what Playwright caught

entry.content:
While reviewing the China read-only mirror on a desktop screen, several layout and wording problems stood out that had been sitting on the main site too. None of them broke functionality, which is why they survived for weeks, but looking at full-page screenshots made them hard to ignore.

Four small layout and copy issues

  1. The single-column footer. Under 功能导航, 8 links ran down one tall column while the three official-link and system columns beside it were only 3 to 4 rows tall, leaving a gap under most of the footer. Splitting 功能导航 into a 2-column grid (10 links including 找选修课 and 学费查询, 5 rows × 2) leveled the whole footer row, and trimming the last homepage section’s bottom padding removed roughly 160 px of dead space above it.
  2. An empty bottom-right hero card. On the home page, KeyDatesCard listed 4 upcoming dates and 常用系统 below it was a pile of small pills with half a blank white box underneath. Raising the homepage date list to 6 rows and turning 常用系统入口 into a 2-column grid of cards with a one-line purpose under each name (Moodle · 课件与作业, WES · 选课与成绩, Allocate+ · 排课表选班) filled the card with useful context instead of padding.
  3. Header wording and hierarchy. New students didn’t immediately tell 课程 (unit lookup) apart from 专业与学位 (degree structure), and 给家长看 sat as plain grey text tucked beside the search bar where families missed it. Renaming the labels to 课程查询, 学费查询 and 家长入口, putting 官方指南 first, promoting WAM/GPA and 学费查询 to the top bar, keeping 选课工具 focused on the three course-selection tools (选课规划, 先修图, 找选修课) and styling 家长入口 as a soft blue pill made the top bar much easier to scan.
  4. Sticky guide outlines and unit next steps. Moving the heading outline on /guides/[slug] into a sticky sidebar TOC kept navigation visible while reading long policy pages, and adding a short “Plan next” card at the bottom of /units/[code] gave readers a direct jump to the prerequisite tree, semester planner or year comparison.

What Playwright caught before PR #301 could merge

Local unit tests (vitest) and nuxi typecheck passed, so I opened PR #301. GitHub Actions ran the Playwright suite across desktop and phone viewports and failed 2 tests (4 runs out of 76):

  • e2e/tests/pwa.spec.ts:32 asserted that the Chinese /manifest.webmanifest shortcuts list contained '课程'. Because the manifest reads nav.units, renaming it to '课程查询' updated the PWA shortcut automatically — a good reminder that one i18n key can feed surfaces outside the main page chrome.
  • e2e/tests/units.spec.ts:57 checked page.getByRole('link', { name: /比较年份|Compare years/ }) without .first(). Adding the bottom planning card on /units/[code] introduced a second “Compare years” link on the page, triggering Playwright’s strict-mode violation.

Both were two-line test updates, and catching them in CI meant zero surprises on deploy.

The CSS Grid stretch I only spotted after shipping

Right after PR #301 deployed to the overseas site, one visual bug jumped out immediately on the home page: the 8 entry tiles on the left looked like tall, narrow grey strips with huge empty bottoms.

The cause was simple once I looked at the two columns side by side:

  • .hero uses align-items: stretch, and .tools had flex: 1 1 auto; grid-auto-rows: 1fr;.
  • Expanding the right column (6 key dates + 2-column system cards) added roughly 220 px of height.
  • On the China read-only view, .tools had 9 tiles in a 3×3 grid (3 rows), so each tile stayed close to a comfortable square (~175 px tall).
  • On the overseas view, .tools still had 8 tiles in a 4×2 grid (only 2 rows) and didn’t include 找选修课 (/electives) at all — so CSS Grid stretched those 2 rows to ~270 px each, while align-content: start pinned the icon and text to the top.

The fix in PR #303 was cleaner than adding a height cap: unify both modes on the same 3×3 grid by adding 找选修课 to the overseas tiles (keeping 社区 in slot 9 overseas and 马莫百科 in slot 9 on the China mirror), switch .tool from align-content: start to align-content: center, and use grid-template-rows: 1fr auto on .hero-side so the systems box stays compact regardless of campus.

While looking at the same screenshots, I also changed the WeChat block heading from 马莫同学写的公众号 (slightly awkward phrasing) to 马莫学生运营的公众号, since the card covers articles, the Q&A bot and the QR code rather than just posts.
entry.summary: Fixing a lopsided footer, buried parent entry, stretched 4x2 home tiles and two Playwright E2E failures caught before merge.

entry.title: 在 50% 丢包的跨境链路上同步 18 张 PostgreSQL 公开表

link.title: 在 50% 丢包的跨境链路上同步 18 张 PostgreSQL 公开表

entry.content:
给 Monash Hub 搭好国内只读镜像以后，国内这台 PostgreSQL 需要从海外主库同步 Handbook 和官方指南数据，但只能同步公开表。海外主库全程只读，用户、认证、通知、评价和社区表一行都不能出库

数据量其实不大，18 张公开表用 gzip 压完大概 100 MB。网络正常时几秒就传完了，但晚高峰实测跨境链路丢包率接近 50%、RTT 约 228 ms，单流 pg_dump | ssh 直接卡在 5.5 KB/s，五分钟只挪了 512 KB

下面的记录隐去了真实主机名、IP、端口和密钥

让传输在高丢包下跑得动

高延迟叠加高丢包时，单条 TCP 连接会被拥塞控制压得很惨。我把同步脚本（deployment/sync-cn-public-data.sh）改成四步后，实测整体提速了约 16 倍：

  1. 只读白名单导出 + 更高压缩率：脚本在海外容器里只对显式列出的 18 张公开表跑 pg_dump --data-only --no-owner --no-privileges，经 SSH gzip -1 拉回本地后，再用 xz -T0 -6 多核重压，体积从约 100 MB 降到约 54 MB
  2. 上传前做本地隐私审计：文件发出前先在本地解压扫描，用正则核对 16 张禁用表（users、email_verification_codes、notifications、auth_throttle、community_*、unit_reviews、search_terms、alembic_version 等），只要命中任意一张立刻中止
  3. 1 MB 分片 + 8 并发 scp 重试：用 split -b 1m 把 54 MB 切成 54 个独立分片，xargs -P 8 开 8 个 scp 并发传，每片失败最多重试 4 次并配 ServerAliveInterval=10。哪怕某一片碰上 scp: Connection closed，也只重传这 1 MB，不会连累另外 53 片
  4. 端到端 SHA256 校验：目标机把分片拼回完整文件后，比对远端 sha256sum 和本地算出的哈希，不一致拒绝导入

最近一次同步（PR #299 给 962 个学位补齐了 reference_links 之后），54 个分片在 503 秒内全部传完并校验通过，虽然比不上局域网，但在晚高峰也足够稳

顺手踩到的三个坑

1. --data-only 恢复遇到循环外键

pg_dump --data-only 导出时就提示 unit_requisite_groups 和 curriculum_containers 存在自引用/循环外键约束，直接执行 COPY 可能因为行顺序报外键错

因为目标库是隔离的只读镜像，把整个恢复包进单个事务里就能同时保证速度和原子性：

BEGIN;
SET LOCAL session_replication_role = 'replica';
TRUNCATE TABLE <18 张白名单公开表> RESTART IDENTITY CASCADE;
-- 接 xz -dc 解压流
COMMIT;
ANALYZE;

中途任何一步失败都会自动回滚，不会把线上旧数据冲坏；SET LOCAL 在事务结束时自动恢复默认行为，最后的 ANALYZE 立刻刷新查询规划统计信息

2. xargs -n 1 bash -c 的参数位置偏移

从交互 shell 整理成独立脚本后，第一次跑立刻报 cp: <host>: No such file or directory

原因是原来写成了这样：

find "$LOCAL_CHUNKS" -maxdepth 1 -name 'part-*' | sort | xargs -n 1 -P "$PARALLEL_CHUNKS" bash -c '
  f="$1"
  dst_host="$2"
  remote_dir="$3"
  ...
' _ "$DST_HOST" "$REMOTE_CHUNKS"

xargs -n 1 是把管道传进来的文件名拼在整条命令的最后，而不是紧跟在 _ 后面。所以 $1 其实是 $DST_HOST，$2 是 $REMOTE_CHUNKS，真正的文件路径在 $3。把三个变量的顺序对调后问题立刻消失

3. 同步数据前必须先对齐表结构

海外库升级到 Alembic 迁移 d7a1e3b5c902（给 courses、areas_of_study 和 curriculum_containers 加了 reference_links 字段）之后，如果国内库没先跑迁移就直接同步 --data-only，COPY 会直接因为列数不一致报错。安全顺序固定为：传新代码 → 跑 alembic upgrade head → 重建 api 和 web → 再跑 sync-cn-public-data.sh

顺带解决国内机 Docker 构建超时

国内云服务器构建后端镜像时，直接连 pypi.org 经常超时。不想把国内镜像源写死进共用 Dockerfile，就在 backend/Dockerfile 和 frontend/Dockerfile 里各加了一个默认为空的可选构建参数：

ARG PIP_INDEX_URL=""
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir ${PIP_INDEX_URL:+-i "$PIP_INDEX_URL"} -r /srv/backend/requirements.txt

前端用同样的方式加了 ARG NPM_REGISTRY=""。海外构建不传参时行为完全不变，国内的 docker-compose.cn.yml 传入镜像源地址，构建从反复超时缩短到不到半分钟
entry.summary: 在晚高峰 50% 丢包的跨境链路上，用 xz 压缩、1 MB 并发分片 scp 和事务内 replica 模式恢复，把 18 张 PostgreSQL 公开表安全同步到国内节点

entry.title: Syncing 18 public PostgreSQL tables across a lossy cross-border link

link.title: Syncing 18 public PostgreSQL tables across a lossy cross-border link

entry.content:
When I stood up the China mainland read-only mirror of Monash Hub, the database on the mainland host needed the public Handbook and official-guide tables from my overseas PostgreSQL instance — and nothing else. The overseas server is treated as strictly read-only for this job, and no user, auth, notification, review or community table may ever leave it.

The data is not huge: 18 public tables, roughly 100 MB when gzipped. On a clean network that takes a few seconds. On an evening cross-border link with roughly 50% packet loss and ~228 ms RTT, a single TCP stream stalled at ~5.5 KB/s and moved only 512 KB in five minutes.

Hostnames, IPs, ports and credentials are omitted below.

Making the transfer survive packet loss

TCP congestion control punishes a single connection hard when half the packets drop at high latency. Rewriting the sync script (deployment/sync-cn-public-data.sh) around four simple changes brought the transfer time down by roughly 16×:

  1. Read-only whitelist dump + stronger compression. The script runs pg_dump --data-only --no-owner --no-privileges against an explicit 18-table whitelist on the overseas container, streams it through gzip -1 over SSH to my local machine, and re-compresses locally with xz -T0 -6. That shrinks the ~100 MB gzip stream to ~54 MB.
  2. Local privacy audit before upload. Before anything goes to the mainland host, the script checks the decompressed SQL stream against a regex of all 16 forbidden tables (users, email_verification_codes, notifications, auth_throttle, community_*, unit_reviews, search_terms, alembic_version, etc.) and aborts on any match.
  3. 1 MB chunks uploaded in parallel with retries. split -b 1m cuts the 54 MB archive into 54 independent pieces, and xargs -P 8 runs 8 concurrent scp workers, each retrying up to 4 times with ServerAliveInterval=10. Even when one worker hits scp: Connection closed, it retries that single 1 MB piece without restarting the other 53.
  4. End-to-end SHA256 verification. The target host concatenates the chunks, checks sha256sum against the hash computed locally, and refuses to restore on a mismatch.

On the latest sync (after PR #299 added reference_links to 962 degrees), all 54 chunks landed and verified in 503 seconds — still not LAN speed, but completely reliable even during peak cross-border congestion.

Three snags I hit along the way

1. Circular foreign keys on --data-only restore

pg_dump --data-only immediately warned that unit_requisite_groups and curriculum_containers have self-referencing / circular foreign-key constraints, meaning plain COPY statements can fail depending on row order.

Because the restore runs inside a single transaction on an isolated read-only mirror, wrapping it like this keeps it both fast and atomic:

BEGIN;
SET LOCAL session_replication_role = 'replica';
TRUNCATE TABLE <18 whitelisted public tables> RESTART IDENTITY CASCADE;
-- xz -dc dump stream
COMMIT;
ANALYZE;

If anything fails mid-restore, the transaction rolls back and the previous dataset stays intact. SET LOCAL automatically resets session_replication_role when the transaction ends, and ANALYZE updates planner statistics immediately afterward.

2. The xargs -n 1 bash -c argument-order bug

When I moved from an interactive shell function to a standalone bash script, the first run failed immediately with cp: <host>: No such file or directory.

I had written:

find "$LOCAL_CHUNKS" -maxdepth 1 -name 'part-*' | sort | xargs -n 1 -P "$PARALLEL_CHUNKS" bash -c '
  f="$1"
  dst_host="$2"
  remote_dir="$3"
  ...
' _ "$DST_HOST" "$REMOTE_CHUNKS"

xargs -n 1 appends the piped filename at the end of the command line, not right after _. So $1 was $DST_HOST, $2 was $REMOTE_CHUNKS, and the actual chunk path was $3. Swapping the assignments fixed it cleanly.

3. Schema drift before data sync

Because the overseas database already had Alembic migration d7a1e3b5c902 (adding reference_links JSONB columns to courses, areas_of_study and curriculum_containers), running a --data-only sync before migrating the mainland database would have failed on mismatched COPY column lists. The safe order is always: deploy code → alembic upgrade head → rebuild api and web → run sync-cn-public-data.sh.

Optional mirror args for slow PyPI and npm builds

Building the backend Docker image on the mainland server also timed out against pypi.org. Rather than hardcoding a regional mirror into the shared Dockerfiles, I added optional empty-by-default build args:

ARG PIP_INDEX_URL=""
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir ${PIP_INDEX_URL:+-i "$PIP_INDEX_URL"} -r /srv/backend/requirements.txt

The frontend Dockerfile does the same with ARG NPM_REGISTRY="". Overseas builds leave both empty and use upstream defaults; docker-compose.cn.yml passes domestic mirrors so rebuilds finish in under half a minute instead of timing out.
entry.summary: Moving 18 whitelisted PostgreSQL tables from an overseas VPS to a mainland cloud server across 50% packet loss using xz, parallel 1 MB scp chunks and atomic replica-mode restore.
